#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# --- 1. Hash the password on the host ---
HASH=$(python3 - <<'EOF'
import base64, hashlib, os
salt = os.urandom(16)
key = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac('sha512', os.environ['MASS_PASSWORD'].encode(), salt, 100000, 64)
print('@ByteArray(' + base64.b64encode(salt).decode() + ':' + base64.b64encode(key).decode() + ')')
EOF
)

# --- 2. Stop qBittorrent, write credentials, start it ---
pct exec 105 -- systemctl stop qbittorrent-nox.service
pct exec 105 -- sed -i '/^\[Preferences\]/a WebUI\\Username=admin\nWebUI\\Password_PBKDF2='"$HASH" /var/lib/qbittorrent-nox/.config/qBittorrent/qBittorrent.conf
pct exec 105 -- systemctl start qbittorrent-nox.service

# --- 3. Prove the login from the host ---
sleep 3
LOGIN=$(curl -s -d "username=admin&password=$MASS_PASSWORD" http://192.168.1.24:8080/api/v2/auth/login)
if [ "$LOGIN" != "Ok." ]; then
    echo "LOGIN FAILED: $LOGIN" >&2
    exit 1
fi
echo "qBittorrent login: Ok."

# --- 4. Update Radarr download client ---
RADARR_KEY=$(pct exec 103 -- sh -c 'sed -n "s:.*<ApiKey>\(.*\)</ApiKey>.*:\1:p" /var/lib/radarr/config.xml | head -n 1')
RADARR_CLIENT_ID=$(curl -s -H "X-Api-Key: $RADARR_KEY" http://192.168.1.22:7878/api/v3/downloadclient | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d[0]['id'] if d else '')")

if [ -n "$RADARR_CLIENT_ID" ]; then
    curl -s --fail-with-body -X PUT \
        -H "X-Api-Key: $RADARR_KEY" \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d '{"id":'"$RADARR_CLIENT_ID"',"name":"qBittorrent","implementation":"QBittorrent","enable":true,"protocol":"torrent","priority":1,"fields":[{"name":"host","value":"192.168.1.24"},{"name":"port","value":8080},{"name":"username","value":"admin"},{"name":"password","value":"'"$MASS_PASSWORD"'"},{"name":"movieCategory","value":"radarr"}]}' \
        http://192.168.1.22:7878/api/v3/downloadclient/"$RADARR_CLIENT_ID"
    echo ""
    curl -s --fail-with-body -X POST \
        -H "X-Api-Key: $RADARR_KEY" \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d '{"id":'"$RADARR_CLIENT_ID"'}' \
        http://192.168.1.22:7878/api/v3/downloadclient/test
    echo ""
fi

# --- 5. Update Sonarr download client ---
SONARR_KEY=$(pct exec 104 -- sh -c 'sed -n "s:.*<ApiKey>\(.*\)</ApiKey>.*:\1:p" /var/lib/sonarr/config.xml | head -n 1')
SONARR_CLIENT_ID=$(curl -s -H "X-Api-Key: $SONARR_KEY" http://192.168.1.23:8989/api/v3/downloadclient | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d[0]['id'] if d else '')")

if [ -n "$SONARR_CLIENT_ID" ]; then
    curl -s --fail-with-body -X PUT \
        -H "X-Api-Key: $SONARR_KEY" \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d '{"id":'"$SONARR_CLIENT_ID"',"name":"qBittorrent","implementation":"QBittorrent","enable":true,"protocol":"torrent","priority":1,"fields":[{"name":"host","value":"192.168.1.24"},{"name":"port","value":8080},{"name":"username","value":"admin"},{"name":"password","value":"'"$MASS_PASSWORD"'"},{"name":"tvCategory","value":"tv-sonarr"}]}' \
        http://192.168.1.23:8989/api/v3/downloadclient/"$SONARR_CLIENT_ID"
    echo ""
    curl -s --fail-with-body -X POST \
        -H "X-Api-Key: $SONARR_KEY" \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d '{"id":'"$SONARR_CLIENT_ID"'}' \
        http://192.168.1.23:8989/api/v3/downloadclient/test
    echo ""
fi

echo "DONE"
